scan.description: Device reports an NFC card scan result to the server.

allowed.description: Whether the key is in the local allowlist

machine_active.description: Current machine-mode latch state (only present in machine mode)

uptime_s.description: Seconds since device boot (lets tests distinguish a runtime reconnect from a reboot)

keys_checksum.description: sha256_hex(sorted(local allowlist uids).join(',')) — lets the server detect drift and republish cmd_sync

cmd_trigger.description: Server triggers a physical action on the device (LED/relay/buzzer).

cmd_sync.description: Server pushes the full authoritative key list (retained message).
